Class FrameWorkBudget

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.client.FrameWorkBudget
public final class FrameWorkBudget extends Object
Manages cooperative performance and frame time budgets shared by uploads, previews, and export work.

Driver calls are indivisible.
